title: The Buster Bailey band with Vic Dickenson and Dick Wellstood
summary: He lists another fine band with Bailey, Dickenson, Wellstood and Cliff Leeman that survived almost a year before running out of jobs.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well - I had Buster Bailey in that band.
Well, that was the other band.
Well, it was almost the same band - but the same guys, you know.
That band you're going...the Bear records.
That was different--- well, but I had so damn many.
Well, let's name that band too because that's interesting.
Buster Bailey on clarinet and Dick Wellstood on piano and Cliff Leeman on drums and Willie Wayman on bass - who was on trombone?
Buster Bailey was on clarinet -- we can't think who was on trombone---

Yeah - well, now, there was a hell of a band -- now, see, I had those kinds of bands and couldn't keep them together. It was just luck - plain luck that we stayed together almost a year - that band.
